title: The Guest in Blue Robes
next_chapter_hook: The riddle she left echoed in his ears—'Moon before Misty Mountain, Reflecting Past Years'—and the turtle shell talisman in Chen Ji's hand suddenly burned hot, as if responding to something.

text.content: Deep in the bamboo grove, moonlight fell like frost. Chen Ji gripped the scalding turtle shell talisman, his knuckles white from tension. The Founding Ancestor—that being who had long ascended according to legend—was actually the one secretly watching him? The karmic connections were far more intricate than he had imagined. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang low in his mind: 'Be careful, some truths... knowing them brings only misfortune.'

A gust of night wind brushed past, rustling the bamboo leaves. As Chen Ji pondered deeply, he suddenly felt a chill behind him—that sensation of being locked onto by a hunter. An ordinary disciple might not detect it, but after three years with the Tianji Record, he had become extremely sensitive to such scrutiny. Unlike the previous vague observations, this presence was... close at hand, with undisguised probing intent.

dialogue.content: 'Brother Chen Ji, alone here late at night, are you contemplating some profound martial technique?'

text.content: The voice was cold and clear as a spring, yet it caused Chen Ji's back to tense instantly. He didn't turn around, slowly tucking the turtle shell talisman into his sleeve, his face already wearing its customary honest expression: 'Senior Sister Su? What brings you here?' As he turned, he saw who had arrived—a blue silk dress, jade pendant at her waist, eyes like cold stars, precisely the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao. Yet tonight, she lacked her usual sharpness, carrying instead an indescribable... scrutiny.

dialogue.content: 'I observed Brother's earlier expression was grave, as if encountering something difficult to resolve.' Su Qingyao stepped forward slowly, the moonlight outlining her cold features. 'Three years as a servant, your skill at concealing brilliance truly impresses me, Brother.'

'Senior Sister jokes,' Chen Ji scratched his head, looking dazed. 'The disciple was merely... merely thinking about tomorrow's duties at the servants' quarters, needing to fetch water from the back mountain before dawn...'

'Is that so?' Su Qingyao chuckled lightly, but her smile didn't reach her eyes. 'Then what is that spiritual light in your sleeve, Brother? I sensed its aura... seems rather similar to some ancient relic from legends.'

text.content: The topic shifted, and Chen Ji understood—she had come for the Tianji Record. For three years he had been careful, never showing the slightest flaw before Su Qingyao, but this Inner Sect Senior Fellow's intuition was simply too sharp, getting infinitely close to the truth again and again, only to be skillfully resolved by him each time. Tonight she chose to reveal herself, likely having obtained some crucial evidence. In his sleeve, the turtle shell talisman grew hot again, as if warning him.

dialogue.content: 'Tianji Record.' Su Qingyao uttered these three words, her gaze like a blade cutting into Chen Ji's eyes. 'The incomplete ancient tome, capable of glimpsing three hours of heavenly secrets, though each use demands the price of 'Heavenly Fate Value'—am I correct?'

text.content: The air seemed to freeze for a moment. Chen Ji maintained his honest facade, but his mind was already racing: She knows about the Tianji Record, even about the existence of Heavenly Fate Value—this was definitely not intelligence obtainable through ordinary channels. Who stands behind her? Old Sect Master's spy, or... someone else? Mo Xiansheng remained silent, as if waiting for him to decide on his own.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao pressed closer and closer. Chen Ji had to make a choice between exposure and continuing to disguise—

choices.text: Continue to play the fool, probe how much she knows
choices.description: Maintain the useless person persona, use ignorance to test Su Qingyao's intelligence source and true purpose, see if she truly has concrete evidence.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to obtain crucial information
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the disguise, maintain current safe situation
choices.risk_hint: Since Su Qingyao dares to reveal herself, she must have cards to play. Continuing to play the fool may backfire

dialogue.content: 'T-Tianji Record?' Chen Ji stared wide-eyed, looking bewildered. 'Senior Sister speaks of what book? Disciple reads little, never heard of it...' He stepped back half a pace, voice trembling, exactly like a servant disciple who had been scared out of his wits.

text.content: Su Qingyao frowned slightly, seemingly discerning the truth in his words. After a moment, she drew a jade slip from her sleeve and lightly tossed it to Chen Ji: 'Since Brother doesn't know, then look at this. At the Sect Council Hall in three days, I hope you can attend. Then, we shall 'chat' properly.'

choices.text: Acknowledge frankly, seize the initiative to probe her
choices.description: Abandon pretense, face Su Qingyao as an equal, directly ask her purpose and intelligence source, strive for the initiative.
choices.visible_cost: Expose partial trump cards, lose disguise advantage
choices.visible_reward: May gain crucial allies, open new intelligence channels
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's stance is unclear; frankness may expose more weaknesses

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sighed softly, that honest facade gradually fading from his face, replaced by a cold, tranquil calm: 'Since Senior Sister Su has investigated this far, continuing to pretend would be futile. The Tianji Record—I indeed have it.'

text.content: A flash of surprise crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, then transformed into something complex—like finally confirming something, yet also like relief. She stepped forward, under the moonlight the two stood so close they could hear each other's breathing. 'I have waited for this day for a very long time.' Her voice lowered. 'Chen Ji, I came to offer you a deal.'

choices.description: Neither confirm nor deny, maintain silence to observe Su Qingyao's next move, seek flaws or sincerity from her reactions.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Su Qingyao, causing the situation to stagnate
choices.visible_reward: Don't expose stance, preserve all options
choices.risk_hint: Silence may be seen as心虚 or arrogance, both parties may fall into stalemate

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, simply gazing quietly at Su Qingyao. Under the moonlight, his eyes were deep as an abyss, as if hiding countless secrets. This silence lasted a full ten breaths, bamboo leaves rustled in the wind, and无形 tension filled the air.

dialogue.content: '...Very well.' Su Qingyao broke the silence first, her tone carrying a hint of admiration. 'No wonder the Tianji Record chose you. Fine, I'll be direct—I know about the Founding Ancestor's matter, and I know where that gaze you were tracking came from. I can help you, but I have one condition.'

'Condition?' Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, his gaze falling on Su Qingyao's cold features. 'Senior Sister Su, an Inner Sect Senior Fellow, wishes to make a deal with this servant—shouldn't you let me know what the price is?'

text.content: Su Qingyao remained silent for a moment, as if weighing her words. Finally, she spoke: 'What the Founding Ancestor left behind isn't limited to the Tianji Record alone. I need you to use the Tianji Record to investigate something for me—what is the truth behind the massacre at Misty Mountain thirty years ago?' Her voice trembled slightly, emotions barely contained. 'In exchange, I will tell you who was secretly watching you back then, and... who your father last met before his disappearance.'

dialogue.content: 'Father...' Chen Ji's heart trembled violently, yet his expression remained unchanged. 'Senior Sister Su certainly knows a great deal about my family affairs.'
'Likewise.' Su Qingyao murmured softly. 'Your trump cards I have yet to fully discern, yet you already know my purpose—this game, we are evenly matched. What do you say, Chen Ji?'

choice.prompt: The bait Su Qingyao offered was far too tempting—his father's clues, the Founding Ancestor's secret. What choice should Chen Ji make?

choices.text: Agree to cooperate, accept her conditions
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to help her investigate the truth, while exchange for clues about his father. Risks and opportunities coexist, but may open a new situation.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and intelligence support, plus clues about his father
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's purpose is unclear; she may have hidden intentions

text.content: Chen Ji沉思片刻，终于点头：'好。但我有言在先——天机录每次动用都有代价，雾隐山的真相……我只能尽力而为。' 苏青瑶眼中闪过一丝笑意：'够了。' 采纳了这个选择。

dialogue.content: 'Senior Sister Su,' Chen Ji微微一笑，'空口无凭的道理，想必你也懂。不如你先告诉我，当年那道注视者的身份，我自会验证你的诚意。'

text.content: Su Qingyao眯起眼睛打量他片刻，忽而轻笑：'你倒是比我想象中更谨慎。好，我告诉你——那道注视，来自老掌门凌渊的命灯。'

choices.memory_label: 凌渊一直在暗中监视陈机

choices.description: Su Qingyao's intelligence was too tempting, which反而令陈机警惕。He decided not to get involved in her plans, maintain his freedom.
choices.visible_cost: 失去获取父亲线索的机会
choices.visible_reward: 保持神秘，不暴露更多信息
choices.risk_hint: 苏青瑶可能转为敌人，且失去重要情报来源

dialogue.content: 'Senior Sister Su's kindness, disciple accepts with gratitude.' Chen Ji垂下眼帘，'只是杂役的身份虽然卑微，却也自在。卷进这些是非之中，怕是没有好下场。'

text.content: Su Qingyao's expression stiffened slightly, then恢复了那副清冷模样：'也好。只是陈机，你迟早会发现——有些事，不是想躲就能躲开的。' She turned to leave, then paused. '最后送你一句话：雾隐山前月，照见旧年人。你父亲留下的东西，比你想象的要多。'

Su Qingyao's silhouette disappeared into the bamboo grove's end, leaving only a faint fragrance. Chen Ji stood alone under the moonlight, the riddle echoing endlessly in his mind—'Moon before Misty Mountain, Reflecting Past Years.' The year his father disappeared, he was still in swaddling clothes; now the only things left were a turtle shell talisman of unknown origin, and... that perpetually blurred scene within the Tianji Record. The turtle shell talisman in his sleeve grew hot once more, as if responding to something. He lowered his gaze to see several faint patterns emerging on the talisman's surface, seemingly resonating with the 'Misty Mountain' Su Qingyao had mentioned. Mo Xiansheng's voice finally响起，带着几分凝重：'她知道的太多了……小子，你父亲当年，究竟卷入了什么？' Chen Ji offered no response, merely gripping the talisman tighter. Moonlight bathed him, revealing a fleeting锋芒 in his eyes—Su Qingyao's intelligence might be precisely the key to his truth. The question was: should he accept this key...

dialogue.content: 'Whatever you decide,' Mo Xiansheng's voice低沉，'记住——天机录选中你，绝非偶然。初代祖师、老掌门的注视、你父亲的失踪……这些线索，终有一日会交汇在一处。'

text.content: 夜风渐凉，陈机深吸一口气，将纷乱的思绪压下。无论苏青瑶是敌是友，她留下的这条线索都太过重要——父亲、雾隐山、初代祖师、凌渊……这些看似散落的棋子，似乎正逐渐拼凑成一幅完整的棋局。远处，天青宗的晨钟隐约传来。陈机收敛气息，重新戴上那副憨厚的面具，缓步走向杂役殿的方向。新的一日开始了，而他与苏青瑶之间的这场博弈，才刚刚拉开序幕。只是他不知道的是，在他身后不远处的一棵古松之上，一道隐匿的气息正注视着这一切——那气息与凌渊命灯中的监视之意一脉相承，却又多了几分……审视的意味。
